description: This file contains Hungarian localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the input is too long, with the excess character count.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the input is too short, with the number of characters needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message when the maximum number of selections is reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when searching is in progress.
